Fact: data_scope
What to find: Scope and main characteristics of the training data (domains, languages, geography, modality coverage).
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Training data consists primarily of filtered and improved open-source vision-language datasets, supplemented by domain-specific data from internal Microsoft teams and targeted data acquisitions; it mixes reasoning and non-reasoning data (including safety-oriented samples), covers text and image-text pairs, and is primarily English.
quotes: The training data consists primarily of meticulously filtered and improved open-source vision-language datasets, supplemented by high-quality domain-specific data from internal Microsoft teams and targeted data acquisitions.
The model is trained primarily on English text and image-text pairs.
Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision-15B is trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a carefully curated mixture of reasoning and non-reasoning data.
